## Checklist for new Component

<!-- If applicable, delete this part otherwise -->

- [ ] Design matches figma
- [ ] Use design tokens, raw values should be avoided
- [ ] Usage of existing Aurora components to build the new component, if
      applicable
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Visual tests
- [ ] Storybook
- [ ] Documentation if the usage of the component is not standard
- [ ] The component is exported in main.ts
- [ ] Accessibility (contrasts, screen reader, keyboard navigation, ... )
- [ ] No hard coded texts, i18n texts should be passed as Props
